text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Algeria's workers mourn union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda. It is not easy to understand his assassination and the reasons behind it. Benhamouda had already escaped several "terrorist" death attempts and adapted himself to the difficult situation experienced by the country.

- Benhamouda killed: A man of conviction who left no one immune to his ideas since the setting up of National Committee for the Safeguarding of Algeria until the annoucement that he would step down from the union to head a political party this year. Benhamouda appeared as the key man in the political debate. Who assassinated him? For whom does the crime benefit? These are questions on everybody's lips.
- Benhamouda was the man who upset many political plans and calculations at a very difficult stage of the Algerian situation. Who assassinated him, or rather who masterminded his elimination?
- Benhamouda screamed out after he was shot: "My brother Kamel, they betrayed us". His killers emptied at least 14 bullets into his body.
- Slain union boss had a gun and shot back before he succumbed and died.
